title: Geometry Dash Shards
blurb: Shards are Geometry Dash's grind currency, and this tinkling collect sound is what pays you for doing the grinding. It is a deliberately moreish little noise, the kind of audio feedback engineered to make a repetitive loop feel productive. That is a large part of why players will happily replay the same map three dozen times in one evening. Drop it in whenever a genuinely tiny amount of progress deserves an outsized celebration. Progress is progress.
origin: The shard pickup sound from Geometry Dash.
